metadata_acquisition: Repository responses and decoded job logs acquired through the connected GitHub reader. JSON document contents were retained without connector wrappers. Logs preserve decoded UTF-8, BOMs, carriage returns and terminal newlines.
binary_acquisition: All 67 release assets downloaded independently from their returned public browser_download_url; all 11 original Actions ZIPs acquired through the connected artifact reader and then downloaded from its returned byte references. No wheel, receipt or artifact was rebuilt.

ci_runs.derivation: Retained complete original collection; selected only exact workflow path and ID, preserving every selected record unchanged and recording its selected count. The derived file is not represented as an unmodified response from a workflow-specific endpoint.

acquisition_exceptions.observed: HTTP 403; metadata instead acquired through the connected repository reader.

acquisition_exceptions.operation: Connected workflow-specific run list by ci.yml and numeric workflow ID
acquisition_exceptions.observed: URL reader rejected unsupported endpoint with HTTP 400; used complete supported repository run collection and the transparent filtering documented above.

source_ref_capture: main and v0.11.0 tag were both captured at the published source SHA before main advanced. Latest release was v0.11.0.
limitations: This audit checks consistency of acquired GitHub evidence. It is not an independently signed attestation, new build, test rerun, installation rerun, performance experiment, or quality benchmark.
